title: Monitor an airline service agent and build better evaluations

deck.title: Monitor an airline service agent and build better evaluations

exercises.task: Read the request and predict what happens when the update API receives only changed flights instead of the complete itinerary. Try the local simulator.
exercises.expected_output: The original and resulting simulated booking show which untouched flights were preserved or lost. No model call or account is required.
exercises.forge_investigation: Later, locate the actual itinerary arguments in your own discovery conversation.

exercises.expected_output: A stored setup trace with the argument, result, actual timing, and your attribute.
exercises.forge_investigation: Open the tool span and find the attribute you added.

exercises.expected_output: A request-specific statement of the flights to change and the flights to preserve.
exercises.forge_investigation: Compare this expectation with the first saved booking read after running discovery traffic.

exercises.expected_output: One saved discovery conversation with the original booking, tool arguments, returned booking, and final response.
exercises.forge_investigation: Follow one booking update from the passenger request through the tool arguments to its returned booking.

exercises.task: Inspect the first request, then continue the original batch. Completed matching cases are reused.
exercises.run_label: Run the remaining seven discovery requests
exercises.expected_output: Eight unique discovery conversations are saved before the discovery checkpoint completes.
exercises.forge_investigation: Compare a successful booking, recovery, refusal, or unresolved result without treating a missing result as success.

exercises.expected_output: A specific claim linked to one conversation and the operation that supports it.
exercises.forge_investigation: In Insights, check a representative turn and a counterexample before accepting the cluster explanation.

exercises.expected_output: Six actual local tool-only simulator incidents, labeled controlled calibration; zero agent model calls.
exercises.forge_investigation: Compare the omitted-return incident with a valid one-way booking and a request awaiting confirmation. These are not spontaneous live agent failures.

exercises.task: Review the passenger request, original itinerary, recorded operations, and resulting booking. Save a label and the evidence supporting it before drafting tag criteria.
exercises.expected_output: A reviewed turn is saved with its stage and trace identities; monitoring is not marked complete.
exercises.forge_investigation: Use the same reviewed turn in native Alignment and inspect disagreements with the automated judge.

exercises.expected_output: Native criteria, scope, and alignment readback; unavailable features remain explicit.
exercises.forge_investigation: Label turns, test criteria in Alignment, then save chosen criteria before enabling the tag.

exercises.expected_output: Four new executions and precision, recall, coverage, and unavailable-result counts from reviewed labels.
exercises.forge_investigation: Inspect tagged and unflagged turns; check the selected time range and pending processing.

exercises.expected_output: A completed native test gives an explicit match or no-match result; unavailable tests stay missing.
exercises.forge_investigation: Compare the returned judge reason with the same turn and your human label.

exercises.expected_output: Precision and recall on reviewed explicit native tests, with judging and review coverage reported separately.
exercises.forge_investigation: Open the native Alignment example supporting one disagreement.

exercises.expected_output: Reviewed development cases containing the original booking, request, policy, expected behavior, and source links.
exercises.forge_investigation: Open the source turn for a curated case and verify that its starting booking matches.

exercises.expected_output: Checks that reject an unrequested itinerary change and a missing requested change.
exercises.forge_investigation: Compare booking-state checks with the agent’s final completion message.

exercises.expected_output: A validated explanation rubric; malformed and unavailable judgments are distinct.
exercises.forge_investigation: Read the evidence available to the explanation judge before accepting its reason.

exercises.expected_output: One explicit saved explanation judgment, or an unavailable result, using the participant rubric and validator.
exercises.forge_investigation: Open the actual judge request, cited events, and final booking before accepting the judgment.

exercises.expected_output: A free paired adapter test uses the actual curated requests and starting bookings; every repaired case must pass before live development comparisons.
exercises.forge_investigation: Open each regression case’s source turn and distinguish the controlled adapter drill from live agent executions.

exercises.expected_output: Eight matched executions on four development bookings, including the full resulting itinerary.
exercises.forge_investigation: Compare the executed repair, tool arguments, booking state, and trace on the same request.

exercises.expected_output: The tested itinerary code and monitoring criteria are fixed for comparison.
exercises.forge_investigation: Open the exact source and criteria snapshot attached to the frozen version.

exercises.expected_output: Twelve executions: starting and repaired agents on six reserved bookings.
exercises.forge_investigation: In EvalTables, align the same case and inspect preserved flights, completion, time, cost, and missing judgments.

exercises.expected_output: Eight executions: two versions on four subsequent requests, with the frozen monitoring criteria.
exercises.forge_investigation: Check whether the same tag detects remaining issues on both versions.

exercises.expected_output: A Report explaining monitor quality, agent behavior, regression coverage, and limits.
exercises.forge_investigation: Verify one Report claim against its conversation and matching evaluation row.

exercises.expected_output: Native readback confirms that automatic judging for this workshop tag is disabled.
exercises.forge_investigation: Open the tag and confirm its disabled status; do not assume closing the notebook stops judging.
